text:
patrick.hr: Hi team  quick one. We're in London for two weeks and my 3yo needs a routine DTaP booster and seasonal flu shot before preschool starts. The private clinic says they can do both but want confirmation that Aetna will cover for a dependent while we're abroad. I also don't have the new company digital card on my phone. Can benefits advise?
maya.benefits: Hi Patrick  routine childhood immunizations are generally covered under preventive care, but coverage can vary by country/provider. We can do a coverage verification and request a letter of coverage for the clinic so they can bill Aetna directly if they accept assignment. Need dependent full name, DOB, member full name and full member ID or last4, clinic name/address, and dates.
patrick.hr: Dependent: Mateo Lopez / DOB 2026-03-02. Member: Patrick Lopez / DOB 1990-02-14 / member last4 2147. Clinic: Kensington Family Clinic / 12 Thurloe St, London SW7. Appointments 2029-09-03 for DTaP and 2029-09-04 for flu.
aetna-bot: [auto] Case AET-99221 opened for international immunization verification. Please provide copy of dependent enrollment (if available), clinic NPI or local tax ID, and any vaccine product names if known. Expected response 48-72 hours.
maya.benefits: For pediatric vaccines, clinics often use CPT 90723 (DTaP-IPV) or 90715 and 90686/90688 for influenza (age-based). Ask the clinic to include CPT codes on the invoice/claim and a brief medical necessity note (if they add any non-routine vaccine). That speeds adjudication.
lina.peopleops: One admin note  dependent must be enrolled in the plan to be covered. Patrick, did you add Mateo to benefits during open enrollment?
patrick.hr: Yes  I added him when he was born in March; I have a confirmation email but not the ID card. I'll attach the enrollment confirmation to the case.
maya.benefits: Great. We'll request a "letter of coverage" and coverage verification to be emailed to the clinic billing contact. If the clinic will not accept direct billing, keep receipts and we'll assist with expedited reimbursement. Also we can issue a temporary digital card PDF to your email within the hour.
aetna-bot: [auto] Update AET-99221: carrier verified dependent enrollment. Preliminary: immunizations covered under preventive benefit. Letter of coverage and claim routing instructions will be emailed to member and clinic; reference verification number CVR-2029-09-0033.
patrick.hr: Thanks  clinic asked whether assignment of benefits (AOB) is needed so they can bill directly. They also want a contact at the carrier if there are questions.
maya.benefits: We'll include an AOB template and the carrier international claims email in the letter. Also tell clinic to include: dependent full name + DOB, member ID (we'll provide full ID in the secure email), CPT codes (e.g., 90723, 90686), vaccine lot numbers on the invoice if available, and the verification CVR-2029-09-0033.
finance-bot: FYI if member pays out-of-pocket and needs a company medical advance, submit an expense with tag "medical-advance" and attach itemized receipt; finance reviews these on a case-by-case basis.
aetna-bot: [auto] Final: Letter of coverage and claim instructions sent to Kensington Family Clinic and member at 2029-09-01T09:12Z. Please confirm clinic receipt and upload any paid receipts to HRA if you pay.
patrick.hr: Received the letter and the clinic confirmed. They booked the shots for 9/03 and 9/04. Thank you everyone! :pray:
lina.peopleops: Adding a quick checklist in case others hit this while traveling: ```
- Confirm dependent enrollment (screenshot of confirmation helps)
- Request letter of coverage/verification CVR number from benefits
- Ask clinic to include CPTs and vaccine lot numbers
- If clinic will not accept assignment, save itemized receipts and proof of payment
- Upload docs to HRA under "international immunizations"
```
maya.benefits: Marking resolved from benefits side. Reopen if clinic bills member or if reimbursement is needed. :thumbsup:
